column1: # End-to-end answer-quality set for cRAG (Italian, bge-m3 + ollama gen).
# The first measured signal at the ANSWER layer — everything else in the
# suite measures retrieval or the seam. Auto-graded by answers.sh.
# Format: <type><TAB><category><TAB><fact_regex><TAB><question>
#   type      ans = answerable (expect a grounded answer)
#             ooc = out-of-corpus (expect a refusal, "Not in context.")
#   category  expected source category (the doc the answer must come from);
#             grounding check = top-1 retrieved doc is in this category.
#             "-" for ooc rows.
#   fact_regex  case-insensitive ERE the generated answer must contain to
#             count as correct. "-" for ooc rows.
#   question  the user question (Italian).
# NOTE on the corpus: ~/rag-test-data bodies are templated stubs whose only
# reliable extractable facts are the "riduce i costi del 15%" line and the
# "Smart City OS" ambit. So this is a GROSS-FAILURE smoke (hallucination,
# wrong-doc grounding, spurious refusal of answerable Qs), not nuanced
# grading. Swap in real Italian docs + richer facts to make it a yardstick;
# the harness mechanism does not change.
